title: Storm Sorceress Unleashed
description: A female warrior with flowing purple and blue hair leaps from a high-tech platform, wielding a glowing staff that channels intense blue lightning into a massive swirling vortex of purple and cyan energy. Below her is a dark, rainy fantasy cityscape with floating debris and glowing crystals under a dramatic stormy sky.
prompt: A dynamic action scene of a beautiful female warrior with long flowing purple and blue hair, wearing detailed fantasy armor and black boots, leaping from a futuristic metallic platform. She holds a glowing magical staff emitting powerful blue lightning into a massive swirling purple and cyan energy vortex. Heavy rain and stormy atmosphere over a dark fantasy city in the background with glowing elements, cinematic lighting, highly detailed digital painting in a dramatic epic style
